04.A Serial transfer pilot

  • Show All Code
  • Hide All Code
  • View Source

Choosing a dilution factor, 2026-02-02 experiment

Author

Shane Hogle

Published

August 19, 2026

1 Introduction

Strain naming convention: 1287 = Citrobacter koseri 1287, 1977 = Pseudomonas chlororaphis 1977, A = Ancestral/Streptomycin sensitive, E = Evolved/Streptomycin resistant.

This is the pilot that preceded the main serial transfer experiment. Its purpose was to pick a serial dilution factor: each transfer was carried out at three different dilutions in parallel so we could see which one gives a full growth cycle inside a 48 hour window.

  • d1 = 100,000 fold dilution
  • d2 = 1,000 fold dilution
  • d3 = 50 fold dilution

Plates are named h<hours>_d<dilution>, so h96_d2 is the 1,000 fold dilution read at the 96 hour timepoint.

2 Setup

library(lubridate)

source(here::here("R", "generic.R"))

Show/hide code 
data_raw <- here::here("data", "raw", "20260202_serial_transfer_pilot")
data_processed <- here::here(

  "04_serial_transfer_coculture"
)
figs <- here::here("output", "figures")

# make output directories if they don't exist
fs::dir_create(data_processed)
fs::dir_create(figs)

Show/hide code 
samplesheet_coculture <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here(
  data_raw,
  "coculture_samplesheet.xlsx"
))

3 Read growth curves

Note that the 1,000 fold dilution was not read at the 48 hour timepoint, so h48_d2 does not exist.

Show/hide code 
read_pilot_plate <- function(file, sheet, dilution, plate_name, start_hrs) {
  read_logphase_xlsx(here::here(data_raw, file), sheet = sheet, skip = 1) %>%
    left_join(samplesheet_coculture, by = join_by(well)) %>%
    mutate(
      dilution = dilution,
      plate_name = plate_name,
      start_hrs_from_0 = start_hrs
    )
}

Show/hide code 
h48_d1 <- read_pilot_plate(

)

h48_d3 <- read_pilot_plate(
  "Coculture_45h_04-helmi-2026 11-54-19.xlsx", 5, 50, "h48_d3", 0
)

4 Combine, tidy, format

Show/hide code 
coculture_gcurves_sm <- bind_rows(
  h48_d1,
  h48_d3,
  h96_d1,
  h96_d2,
  h96_d3,
  h144_d1,
  h144_d2,
  h144_d3,
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(plate_name, well) %>%
  arrange(plate_name, well) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    OD600_rollmean = slider::slide_dbl(OD600, mean, .before = 2, .after = 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  relocate(OD600_rollmean, .after = "OD600")

# save result for later
readr::write_tsv(
  coculture_gcurves_sm,
  here::here(data_processed, "20260202_pilot_gcurves_smooth.tsv")
)

5 Growth curves with transfers combined

Show/hide code 
p <- coculture_gcurves_sm %>%
  mutate(hours_agg = hours + start_hrs_from_0) %>%
  mutate(
    strainID = paste0(
      str_to_upper(str_sub(evolution, 1, 1)),
      str_sub(strain, 2, 5)
    ),
    growthenv = paste(media, strep_conc_ugml, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    strainID = factor(strainID, levels = c("A1287", "E1287", "A1977", "E1977"))
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    y = mean(OD600_rollmean),
    sd = sd(OD600_rollmean),
    .by = c(
      hours_agg,
      strainID,
      growthenv,
      dilution
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = hours_agg,
  )) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = y - sd, ymax = y + sd, fill = factor(dilution)),
    alpha = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(aes(y = y, color = factor(dilution)), linewidth = 0.75) +
  facet_grid(growthenv ~ strainID) +
  labs(
    y = "OD",
    x = "Total hours from start",
    color = "Serial dilution\nfactor"
  )

ggsave(
  here::here(figs, "20260202_pilot_trial_timecourse.png"),
  p,
  device = "png",
  dpi = 300,
  width = 14,
  height = 8
)

6 Inspect individual growth curves

Show/hide code 
plotter <- function(id) {
  plotplate(
    coculture_gcurves_sm,
    dfxy = NULL,
    unsmoothed = TRUE,
    predicted = FALSE,
    plate = id,
    rows = 8,
    cols = 12,
    page = 1,
    scales = "fixed"
  )
}

# Introduction

Strain naming convention: 1287 = *Citrobacter koseri* 1287, 1977 = *Pseudomonas chlororaphis* 1977, A = Ancestral/Streptomycin sensitive, E = Evolved/Streptomycin resistant.

This is the pilot that preceded the [main serial transfer experiment](02_20260410_format_growthcurves.qmd). Its purpose was to pick a serial dilution factor: each transfer was carried out at three different dilutions in parallel so we could see which one gives a full growth cycle inside a 48 hour window.

- `d1` = 100,000 fold dilution
- `d2` = 1,000 fold dilution
- `d3` = 50 fold dilution

Plates are named `h<hours>_d<dilution>`, so `h96_d2` is the 1,000 fold dilution read at the 96 hour timepoint.

# Setup

## Libraries

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(fs)
library(ggforce)
library(slider)
source(here::here("R", "gcurves.R"))
source(here::here("R", "generic.R"))
```

## Global variables

```{r}
data_raw <- here::here("data", "raw", "20260202_serial_transfer_pilot")
data_processed <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "04_serial_transfer_coculture"
)
figs <- here::here("output", "figures")

# make output directories if they don't exist
fs::dir_create(data_processed)
fs::dir_create(figs)
```

## Read sample metadata

```{r}
samplesheet_coculture <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here(
  data_raw,
  "coculture_samplesheet.xlsx"
))
```

# Read growth curves

Note that the 1,000 fold dilution was not read at the 48 hour timepoint, so
`h48_d2` does not exist.

```{r}
read_pilot_plate <- function(file, sheet, dilution, plate_name, start_hrs) {
  read_logphase_xlsx(here::here(data_raw, file), sheet = sheet, skip = 1) %>%
    left_join(samplesheet_coculture, by = join_by(well)) %>%
    mutate(
      dilution = dilution,
      plate_name = plate_name,
      start_hrs_from_0 = start_hrs
    )
}
```

## 48 hours

```{r}
h48_d1 <- read_pilot_plate(
  "Coculture_45h_04-helmi-2026 11-54-19.xlsx", 2, 100000, "h48_d1", 0
)

h48_d3 <- read_pilot_plate(
  "Coculture_45h_04-helmi-2026 11-54-19.xlsx", 5, 50, "h48_d3", 0
)
```

## 96 hours

```{r}
h96_d1 <- read_pilot_plate(
  "Co-culture_96h_06-helmi-2026 11-54-27.xlsx", 2, 100000, "h96_d1", 45
)

h96_d2 <- read_pilot_plate(
  "Co-culture_96h_06-helmi-2026 11-54-27.xlsx", 5, 1000, "h96_d2", 45
)

h96_d3 <- read_pilot_plate(
  "Co-culture_96h_06-helmi-2026 11-54-27.xlsx", 8, 50, "h96_d3", 45

```

## 144 hours

```{r}
h144_d1 <- read_pilot_plate(
  "Co-culture_6.2_09-helmi-2026 15-48-52.xlsx", 2, 100000, "h144_d1", 96
)

h144_d2 <- read_pilot_plate(
  "Co-culture_6.2_09-helmi-2026 15-48-52.xlsx", 5, 1000, "h144_d2", 96

h144_d3 <- read_pilot_plate(
```

# Combine, tidy, format

```{r}
coculture_gcurves_sm <- bind_rows(
  h48_d1,
  h48_d3,
  h96_d1,
  h96_d2,
  h96_d3,
  h144_d1,
  h144_d2,
  h144_d3,
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(plate_name, well) %>%
  arrange(plate_name, well) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    OD600_rollmean = slider::slide_dbl(OD600, mean, .before = 2, .after = 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  relocate(OD600_rollmean, .after = "OD600")

# save result for later
readr::write_tsv(
  coculture_gcurves_sm,
  here::here(data_processed, "20260202_pilot_gcurves_smooth.tsv")
)
```

# Growth curves with transfers combined

```{r}
p <- coculture_gcurves_sm %>%
  mutate(hours_agg = hours + start_hrs_from_0) %>%
  mutate(
    strainID = paste0(
      str_to_upper(str_sub(evolution, 1, 1)),
      str_sub(strain, 2, 5)
    ),
    growthenv = paste(media, strep_conc_ugml, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    strainID = factor(strainID, levels = c("A1287", "E1287", "A1977", "E1977"))
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    y = mean(OD600_rollmean),
    sd = sd(OD600_rollmean),
    .by = c(
      hours_agg,
      strainID,
      growthenv,
      dilution
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = hours_agg,
  )) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = y - sd, ymax = y + sd, fill = factor(dilution)),
    alpha = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(aes(y = y, color = factor(dilution)), linewidth = 0.75) +
  facet_grid(growthenv ~ strainID) +
  labs(
    y = "OD",
    x = "Total hours from start",
    color = "Serial dilution\nfactor"
  )

ggsave(
  here::here(figs, "20260202_pilot_trial_timecourse.png"),
  p,
  device = "png",
  dpi = 300,
  width = 14,
  height = 8
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: true
#| label: fig-01
#| fig-width: 14

#| fig-cap: Pilot serial transfer time course. Grid columns are the four strains, grid rows are the growth medium and streptomycin concentration. Color is the serial dilution factor, the heavy line is the mean and the ribbon is one standard deviation. The horizontal axis joins all three transfers end to end.
p
```

# Inspect individual growth curves

```{r}
plotter <- function(id) {
  plotplate(
    coculture_gcurves_sm,
    dfxy = NULL,
    unsmoothed = TRUE,
    predicted = FALSE,
    plate = id,
    rows = 8,
    cols = 12,
    page = 1,
    scales = "fixed"
  )
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}
